notes: File digests are over the exact bytes on disk (UTF-8, no BOM, CRLF as authored).
expectedStdout is hashed after normalizing CRLF to LF, so it is host-independent.
The frozen test at the task root must be copied unchanged into the implementation project.

expectedStdout embeds 'frame bytes=373', a deflate output size. That size is fixed for stdx 1.0.5.1 but is not guaranteed across zlib builds, so expectedStdout is an observed artifact of this toolchain, not a portable requirement. The frozen test never asserts an exact compressed size; it only requires payloadLength < rawLength.
expectedDomainInvariants entries other than demoFrameBytes and demoFramePayloadBytes are compression-independent and are asserted by the frozen test.
